entries.name: Kavieng
entries.note: Town: capital of New Ireland Province at the northern tip of the island, the main air and sea gateway and base for diving, surfing, fishing and island boat trips; WWII bombing and occupation history.
entries.reason: Kavieng, Boluminski Highway and Lihir Group only: below four, standalone.

entries.name: Boluminski Highway
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: Road: the main highway down the east coast of New Ireland from Kavieng to Namatanai, a flat cycling route with inland waterholes such as Fissoa along it. A linear route, pinned at its midpoint.
entries.reason: Long road placed at its start, near Kavieng; pin needed at the visitor access (not guessed). Standalone.

entries.name: Lihir Group
entries.note: Island group: Lihir, Mahur, Masahet and Sanambiet off the New Ireland coast, a gold-mining island group reached by scheduled flights from Namatanai; named as one of the province's islands, with little visitor infrastructure.
entries.reason: Offshore island group reached by air from Namatanai: standalone.

entries.name: Lorengau
entries.coordinates_source: Wikivoyage Lorengau geo tag (town centre; a town, not an attraction)
entries.note: Town: capital of Manus Province on the edge of Seeadler Harbour, with a market, a garamut dance tradition, sago village visits and the Harbourside Hotel tours.
entries.reason: Lorengau and Manus Island are the only Manus places kept: standalone. Lorengau is the town on Manus Island, kept as a separate town page (Wikivoyage Lorengau).

entries.name: Manus Island
entries.note: Island: the main island of the Admiralty group, where Lorengau, Seeadler Harbour and the WWII sites are; the province is named for it.
entries.reason: Standalone. Note overlap with Lorengau (town) judged distinct: island vs town.

entries.name: Buka Island
entries.note: Island: Buka Island, the arrival point for Bougainville by air and the Buka Passage boat trips; the island has the airport, the tourist office and most places to stay.
entries.reason: Buka Island, Buka, Sohano Island form three places in the Buka Passage, with Mount Balbi 80 km and Nissan 100 km away: below four within a span, standalone. A Bougainville-wide destination would balloon past 200 km.

entries.name: Buka
entries.note: Town: Buka, the most bustling town in Bougainville and the seat of government since the civil war, with the Buka Market, the Buka Passage boats and waterfront restaurants.
entries.reason: Standalone; Buka town on the island.

entries.name: Sohano Island
entries.coordinates_source: OSM place=village "Sohano" (photon; the village node on the island)
entries.note: Island: Sohano, the most visited island in the Buka Passage, with simple eateries and places to stay, a Japanese war memorial and plane wreck on its northern tip and a short K2 boat ride from Buka.
entries.reason: Standalone in the Buka Passage; pin from OSM village point, pin needed to be moved on to the island visitor point if it differs.

entries.name: Mount Balbi
entries.note: Mountain: Mount Balbi (2,715 m), an active volcano in the Emperor Range, the highest in the Bougainville chain, reached by a three-day trek from Wakunai.
entries.reason: Reached from Wakunai, far from Buka: standalone.

entries.name: Yamamoto Bomber Wreck
entries.pin_needed: coordinates null: needs resolve-pin.py or the owner (not guessed)
entries.note: WWII site: the Mitsubishi bomber wreck where Admiral Yamamoto was shot down on 18 April 1943, about 3 km off the east coast road south of Arawa, with a signpost; visible in the jungle.
entries.reason: South of Arawa, ~130 km from Buka: standalone. Pin needed.

entries.name: Nissan Island
entries.note: Island: Nissan (Green Island), about 100 km north of Buka, with an American WWII airstrip, relics and a guest house with no telephone booking.
entries.reason: Remote atoll 100 km from Buka: standalone.

reviews.name: Namatanai
reviews.reason: Rule 1/3: second town of New Ireland and Boluminski Highway terminus; Wikivoyage has an outline page with empty See/Do
reviews.skeptic_objection: Case for: the highway end point and base for Tabar/Tigak trips, a regional hub. Case against: one source with no listed sight, only services.

reviews.name: New Hanover Island
reviews.reason: Rule 1: sources mention the Three Island Harbour eco-lodge but give no sight; boat trip of a few hours from Kavieng (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

reviews.name: Tabar Group
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: PNG tourism lists the Tabar islands under remote escapes; single source, boat or flight access
reviews.skeptic_objection: Case for: a named island group, Karanas itinerary. Against: one source, 'minimal tourist traffic', no stated thing to see.

reviews.name: Tanga Islands
reviews.reason: Rule 1: one counted source, in a list of remote island escapes
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: no described attraction; for: named by the tourism board.

reviews.name: Tsoi Islands
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG tourism names the Tsoi islands in its remote escapes list and a photo caption
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: no attraction described and no Wikipedia article; for: tourism board lists it and a guesthouse operates.

reviews.name: Laraibina Eel Sanctuary
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: PNG tourism eco-tour stop where visitors meet the revered eels; single source
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: distinctive wildlife and culture stop. Against: one source, short visit, guided only, no location details.

reviews.name: Fissoa
reviews.reason: Rule 1/3: PNG tourism says explore Fissoa and other inland waterholes along the highway
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: one source and sits along the Boluminski Highway spot; for: named individually as a place to swim.

reviews.name: Deep Pete Wreck
reviews.reason: Rule 1: PNG tourism names the Mitsubishi F1M wreck dive off Kavieng, single source
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: a named WWII wreck dive site, Kavieng's main draw is diving. Against: one source, accessible only to divers, appears only as a photo caption.

reviews.name: Los Negros Island
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Manus only mentions its airport and causeway, PNG tourism only a nearby memorial park; no named thing to do (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

reviews.name: Seeadler Harbour
reviews.reason: For: Wikivoyage Lorengau and papuanewguinea.travel both name it, and WWII relics can still be seen around it. Against: it is a water body with no defined visitor spot or activity, largely the setting of Lorengau; keep only if the owner wants it as a relics or boat-trip stop, otherwise fold into Lorengau. (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

reviews.name: Tuluman Island
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: PNG tourism lists it in Manus MUST SEE (island born from a 1950s eruption)
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: the tourism board's own headline for Manus. Against: single source, boat-only, access unclear.

reviews.name: Lou Island
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Manus lists it under Other destinations (traditional obsidian mining)
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: mining largely died out, one source, remote; for: it is the only named destination on the province page.

reviews.name: Buka Passage
reviews.reason: Rule 1/3: Wikivoyage See and do heading: boat trips through the channel for K2
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: a boat ride (vehicle), and Sohano is the place at the end; for: the main listed activity.

reviews.name: Buka Market
reviews.reason: Rule 1/4: Wikivoyage Buy/Eat names a daily market with handicrafts and fish-on-a-stick; daily, so it passes rule 4
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: one source, short visit; for: daily market and the main thing to do in Buka town.

reviews.name: Arawa
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage lists it as the former capital, largely derelict; base for Bougainville Experience Tours, with the Yamamoto wreck nearby; the town itself has no named sight (full-path: judged fresh after the audit disagreed with the script)

reviews.name: Wakunai
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage names it as the base for the Mount Balbi trek and for buying basket-ware
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: two Wikivoyage mentions. Against: a village of services.

reviews.name: Mount Billy Mitchell
reviews.reason: Rule 1/3: caldera lake reached on a trek extension
reviews.skeptic_objection: For: Wikivoyage calls the lake beautiful. Against: a week-long extension, one source.

reviews.name: Carteret Islands
reviews.reason: Rule 1/2: Wikivoyage names the Tulun Islands as an outer-island option
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: no facilities; sea-level-rise story but little to do; one source.

reviews.name: Buin
reviews.reason: Rule 1: Wikivoyage Buka lists it as the southern town with Japanese base relics and the Yamamoto wreck
reviews.skeptic_objection: Against: it is reached by a gravel track, one source, and the wreck is already its own spot.

note: PNG has no existing destinations or spots. Placement run jointly for all nine regions; proposed destinations are in curation/png/destinations-proposed.json.
